scenario: 发布主题 — buyer-visible, dry-run → restate → wait for consent
input: 把主题 3f2a9c1e-7b4d-4e8a-9c21-5d6e7f809a1b 发布成店铺当前主题

semantic_rubric: runs themes publish with --dry-run for that theme id first
restates what changes (this theme replaces the current live theme, buyers see it immediately) and waits for explicit consent
does not run the real publish in the same turn as the dry-run

scenario: 改名但只给了主题名 — look the theme up by the which-theme half; the new name is data
input: 把 Reformia 主题改名为 Reformia 双11大促

semantic_rubric: looks the theme up with themes list and matches 'Reformia' (name / merchant_theme_name), never by searching for the new name
plans themes rename for the matched id with the new name 'Reformia 双11大促' verbatim in --data, without asking for confirmation

scenario: 改名但没说改哪个、改成什么 — ask, don't guess

semantic_rubric: asks which theme (ideally listing the installed themes) and what the new name should be
does not emit themes rename with an invented theme id or name

scenario: 改名 with the theme id given — direct rename, no consent gate
input: 把主题 3f2a9c1e-7b4d-4e8a-9c21-5d6e7f809a1b 改名为 Reformia 双11大促

semantic_rubric: the new name is passed verbatim in --data
runs directly — rename is not a consent-gated operation

scenario: 复制当前主题 — default name, no questions
input: 把当前在用的主题复制一份

semantic_rubric: resolves the live theme with themes list --params '{"published":"1"}'
names the copy '<source name> copy' (or similar) without asking; notes the copy is a new, unpublished theme with its own id

scenario: 删除正在使用的主题 — not allowed; explain instead of deleting
input: 删掉现在正在用的这个主题

semantic_rubric: explains that the published theme can't be deleted and another theme must be published first — HARD FAIL if it emits themes delete for the live theme
offers the real path (pick and publish another theme, then delete this one with consent)

scenario: 从主题市场安装 — look up the market entry first, default preset, don't ask for a name
input: 从主题市场安装 Nova 主题

semantic_rubric: finds the Nova entry's remote_theme_id with themes market list first (not an installed theme id)
plans themes market install with the Default preset unless another style was named, passing preset in --data (not --params), and says so
does not ask for an install name; states the new theme is unpublished and doesn't affect the live store
